title: The Wise Servant
summary: A country master possessed a servant named Hans whom he considered the wisest man in seven counties, because Hans never did anything without thorough consideration....
full_text:
A country master possessed a servant named Hans whom he considered the wisest man in seven counties, because Hans never did anything without thorough consideration.

One afternoon, the master sent Hans to the pasture to search for three lost cows. Hans walked into the meadow, sat down beneath a shady oak, and fell fast asleep for four hours.

When he awoke, he saw three cows grazing peacefully by the brook. Hans thought to himself: "If I drive them home now, they will surely get thirsty on the road. And if they get thirsty, they might drink from the pond and swallow a leech. And if they swallow a leech, they might perish of fever!"

To prevent this tragedy, Hans drove the three healthy cows straight into the town slaughterhouse, sold their meat for a pittance, and bought three wheelbarrows of dry hay, which he pushed home in triumph.

"Where are my cows?" shouted the furious master.

"Master," answered Hans with profound dignity, "I have saved your cattle from lethal leeches and brought you enough hay to feed ten herds!" The master raised his walking stick in despair, while Hans smiled serenely, confident that his profound wisdom had averted a colossal disaster.
moral: Beware of the servant who does more than he is asked and turns every chore into a calamity.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Wise Servant"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
